inspiration: Itanium C++ ABI 2.5 (vtable layout) and 2.9.5 (type_info); the class structures Ghidra's RecoverClassesFromRTTIScript and IDA's GCC RTTI reconstruction build
decisions: No new option and no new value: a refinement of itaniumrtti on, which #1756 introduces.
Vtable types, slot names and slot prototypes are #1756's; this adds the class size, the fields and the receiver on ELF.
A class size is set only with operator delete/new evidence that covers every observed access through this: a too-small struct prints worse than none.
The receiver is an unlocked input hint, not a locked prototype: locking one parameter fixes the arity.
The hint goes on every attributed class, sized or not: #1756's variable-length structure prints no worse than an untyped receiver.
The hint and vtable-object commit is shared with #1810's IOKit commit, not duplicated.

libapt-pkg.so.6.0.0.method: regular expressions over decompile-all output, main plus #1606
